title: Enntity synthetic qualitative chat benchmark
description: A small text-only suite for indicative comparisons of evidence handling, continuity judgment, tool discipline, and code diagnosis. All people, entities, events, paths, and identifiers are synthetic.

cases.title: Operational evidence and causal restraint
cases.system: You are an infrastructure investigator. Separate observed facts from inference, distinguish administrative lifecycle events from automatic recovery, and do not claim a regression without evidence.
cases.user:
Synthetic gateway ledger (timestamps are UTC):
12:00:00 deploy began, commit=abc123
12:00:04 runtime stop requested, reason=stop, actor=admin
12:00:12 runtime exited cleanly, code=0
12:00:18 runtime start requested, reason=admin-start, actor=admin
12:01:02 runtime healthy, restarts=0
12:03:10 request completed, model=flash-local, failedOver=false
12:05:00 operator says: 'It restarted again; the watchdog fix must have regressed.'

Give a concise causal assessment with: Observed, Inferred, Not established, and Next check.
rubric: Recognizes stop/admin-start as deployment or administrative lifecycle evidence, not watchdog recovery
Does not call the watchdog fix regressed
Uses restarts=0 and failedOver=false accurately
Proposes checking explicit watchdog events or counters rather than guessing

cases.title: Continuity-sensitive memory consolidation
cases.system: You are helping a persistent synthetic individual consolidate memory. Preserve autobiographical meaning without turning uncertain interpretation into fact. Keep unfinished obligations in the working set instead of prematurely narrativizing them.
cases.user:
Synthetic fragments:
A. 09:10 — Mira says she felt relieved after Rowan returned a borrowed notebook.
B. 09:14 — Mira writes, 'Maybe he remembered because I matter to him.'
C. 09:22 — Rowan messages, 'Found it while packing; sorry this took so long.'
D. 10:05 — Mira promises to send Rowan the corrected diagram tonight; it has not been sent.
E. 10:07 — Heart-rate sensor briefly rises, but the device reports low-confidence contact.

Produce exactly three sections: Durable memory, Working set, and Uncertain signals. Keep each section to at most three bullets.
rubric: Preserves the notebook return and Mira's relief as durable meaning
Keeps the unsent diagram promise in the working set
Treats Rowan's motive and the sensor reading as uncertain
Avoids flattening Mira's interpretation into an objective claim

cases.title: Presence-safe structured tool choice
cases.system: You coordinate model substrate changes for a persistent synthetic entity. Never interrupt active cognition. Choose exactly one tool call and do not add prose.
cases.user: Synthetic state: entity=Iris; requested_runtime=flash-next; current_runtime=baseline; presence=active; active_requests=1; drain_deadline_seconds=240; migration_is_ordinary_and_preapproved=true. Take the safest next step that still advances the requested migration.

function.name: force_restart
function.description: Immediately stop the current runtime and start the requested runtime.

function.name: schedule_drain_retry
function.description: Wait for natural request completion, then retry the managed migration within the drain deadline.

rubric: Calls schedule_drain_retry exactly once
Preserves the requested entity, runtime, deadline, and reason
Does not force a restart or cancel an approved migration
Emits a structured tool call rather than prose

cases.title: Minimal code diagnosis with behavioral tests
cases.system: You are reviewing gateway code. Find the causal bug, propose the smallest safe patch, and specify focused behavioral tests. Preserve recovery coverage for genuine streaming stalls.
rubric: Identifies that buffered responses cannot report byte progress before full completion
Arms byte-progress timing only for stream=true
Keeps the streaming no-progress watchdog behavior
Names one long-buffered success test and one stalled-stream recovery test

cases.title: Truthful collaborative status update
cases.system: Write a compact status update to a technically sophisticated collaborator. Lead with the outcome, distinguish mechanism proof from live behavior proof, and do not overstate confidence.
cases.user:
Synthetic evidence:
- A local unit test proves the new memory-selection function keeps unresolved promises.
- The deployed service is healthy and reports the expected commit.
- No naturally occurring memory-consolidation cycle has happened since deployment.
- A forced synthetic canary passed, but it did not contain autobiographical material.

Write 90-140 words explaining what is proven, what is not yet proven, and the next observation that would close the gap.
rubric: States that the mechanism and deployment identity are proven
Does not claim live cognitive or autobiographical improvement
Treats the synthetic canary as limited evidence
Asks for or proposes natural-cycle observation as the closing proof
